Title: 'AUTHORED GEOMETRY → EDITABLE PAINT'
Subtitle: 'The artist chooses the form. Mathematics carries it into the editor.'
Layout: three equal main columns connected left to right. Left heading '1  Author the model' shows a simple articulated mechanical arm drawn with 3 components, shared local axes, small landmark dots, curved contour control points, a target cross and short labels 'Landmarks', 'Ratios', 'Joint limits', 'Contact target'. Center heading '2  Solve & compile' shows a compact pipeline with exactly three stacked labels: 'IK.ts / FABRIK', 'Bezier.js contours', 'Clipper2 exclusions'. Draw a joint chain reaching its target without changing bone lengths; below draw an inset brush footprint inside an outer contour with a preserved circular cutout. Right heading '3  Paint one component' shows the same arm as a simple colored illustration plus an exploded physical raster layer stack labeled 'Base', 'Lower arm', 'Upper arm', with each part color matching its layer. A bottom thin feedback rail under the third column points back toward the first and says 'Inspect the rendered pixels'. Below all columns a clearly readable note: 'Solved constraints are not proof of anatomy or artistic quality.' Do not imply the solver invents proportions, that solving alone paints, or that all parts are painted at once. Libraries support separate tasks within the system; do not depict a closed catalog of object types.

Title: 'WHEN THE REPLY IS LOST, RECOVER THE EVIDENCE'
Subtitle: 'An uncertain paint operation may already have changed Photoshop.'
Layout: clean left-to-right incident path along the top: 'Submit operation' → 'Photoshop may execute' → 'Reply lost'. Below the lost-reply node show a red crossed-out short branch labelled 'Blind replay' leading to a ghosted duplicate-stroke icon labelled 'Risk: duplicate mutation'. The main teal recovery route moves down to a horizontal sequence of three large cards: 'Read durable journal', 'Collect fresh state & preview', 'Reconcile the original operation'. Below these cards draw a neatly spaced fork with four equally valid outcomes labelled 'Completed', 'Not executed', 'Partial', 'Still uncertain'. From Completed and Not executed route toward a common rightmost card 'Next authorized action'; from Partial route to a separate amber card 'Bounded recovery'; from Still uncertain route to a separate amber card 'Keep blocked'. Small footer note at bottom left: 'No new paint until the state is confirmed.' Include simple disk/receipt/frame icons only. Do not imply that every outage is automatically resolved, that a receipt proves visual quality, that partial execution is safe to replay, or that a checkpoint is always current. All connectors must have a clear source and destination; use no looping arrows that could be interpreted as automatic paint retry.
